candidates.spoken: What If We Built a Star on Earth?
One gram of fusion fuel: 11 tonnes of coal.
ITER was originally expected to cost approximately €5 billion.
Construction of the ITER complex in France started in 2013.
It's an experiment, not a power station.
It would not all happen at once.
It holds plasma in magnetic fields inside a tokamak.
That's what ITER, in France, aims to harness.

script.spoken: What If We Built a Star on Earth? That's what ITER, in France, aims to harness. It holds plasma in magnetic fields inside a tokamak. Construction began in 2013. The budget grew from €5 billion to €18 to 20 billion. It's an experiment, not a power station. So building a star on Earth starts with proving it can burn.
